about.label: About Us
about.heading: A Leading Legal Practice in Cairo Since 2004
about.body: Founded by Ahmed Ibrahim El-Badry, Aktay Law Firm has established itself as a premier provider of legal services in Cairo, Egypt. We combine decades of courtroom experience with modern legal strategies to deliver exceptional outcomes.
about.mission: Our mission is to deliver high-quality legal services while upholding the highest ethical standards — providing personalized attention to every client.

services.label: Our Services
services.heading: Comprehensive Legal Services
services.sub: We provide tailored legal strategies across a full spectrum of practice areas.
services.s1d: Establishing and incorporating all types and forms of companies, in accordance with all applicable laws both inside and outside the Arab Republic of Egypt.
services.s2d: Providing comprehensive real estate services for both lands and buildings.
services.s3d: Enforcing all legal rulings that must be implemented, both locally and internationally.
services.s4d: Writing family court documents and handling all types of family-related legal problems.
services.s5d: Preparing employment contracts and defending your rights in all work-related court cases.
services.s6d: Drafting all types of personal and legal agreements and representing clients in all civil legal matters.
services.s7d: Attending investigations and defending all criminal cases at all levels of the court system.
services.s8d: Representing clients in all personal status cases including inheritance and legal dependents.
services.s9d: Providing all legal services for companies and individuals in all areas of law, both inside Egypt and abroad.
